name: Mai Chau
provinceNote: Mai Chau was in Hoa Binh, which merged into Phu Tho in 2025.
dotReason: Worth it if you are already nearby
summary: Mai Chau is a valley of rice and stilt houses west of Hanoi, closer and gentler than Sapa. It works as a one-night escape when you want fields without a border-run.
fee: Valley walking is free; some looms and shows are paid
getThere: About 3.5–4.5 hours by road from Hanoi
seoDescription: A closer rice-valley overnight from Hanoi, and how it differs from Sapa.
intro: Mai Chau’s floor is a wide rice valley with Thai stilt houses. The ride from Hanoi crosses a pass and drops into the valley. It is an easier landscape than Ha Giang and a shorter transfer than Sapa.
Stay in a stilt house if you want the point of the trip. The valley is walkable and bicycle-friendly.
gettingAround: A private car or a tourist bus from Hanoi is the usual way in. Bicycles from the homestay cover the valley lanes.

stayAreas.name: Lac village
stayAreas.summary: The main cluster of stilt-house stays.

eat: Dinner is usually at the homestay: grilled meat, forest vegetables, and rice. Eat there rather than hunting for a restaurant.
interestsBody: Rice and a quiet family overnight. Skip it if you are already committed to Sapa or Ha Giang on a short northern leg.

faqs.a: Mai Chau is closer, lower, and calmer. Sapa is higher, mistier, and a bigger journey.
